notes: Printed: '[+1]: Reveal the top card of your library. If it's a creature card, put it into your hand.' Putting a revealed card into your hand is not drawing it (CR 121.1). With your Teferi's Tutelage ('Whenever you draw a card, target opponent mills two cards') on the battlefield, the +1 moves the creature on top (Library 5) into your hand and the opponent mills nothing.
